properties.name: cap.account.default-workspace.name
properties.description: Human-readable name assigned to the first lazily provisioned CAP workspace.

properties.name: cap.account.default-workspace.type
properties.description: Business type assigned to the first lazily provisioned CAP workspace.

properties.name: cap.account.default-workspace.settings.measurement-stale-after
properties.description: Age after which a measurement is considered stale in a newly provisioned workspace.

properties.name: cap.account.default-workspace.settings.default-acidity-basis
properties.description: Default reference acid basis used by a newly provisioned workspace.

properties.name: cap.account.invitation-time-to-live
properties.description: Validity period assigned to a new or resent workspace invitation.

properties.name: cap.query.cursor.time-to-live
properties.description: Validity period of an issued database pagination cursor.

properties.name: cap.query.cursor.active-key.id
properties.description: Identifier of the HMAC key used to sign newly issued pagination cursors.

properties.name: cap.query.cursor.active-key.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded HMAC secret used to sign newly issued pagination cursors.

properties.name: cap.query.cursor.previous-key.id
properties.description: Identifier of the previous HMAC key accepted during cursor-key rotation.

properties.name: cap.query.cursor.previous-key.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded previous HMAC secret accepted during cursor-key rotation.

properties.name: cap.security.clerk.issuer
properties.description: Expected issuer URI of Clerk access tokens.

properties.name: cap.security.clerk.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: URI from which the resource server loads Clerk JSON Web Keys.

properties.name: cap.security.public-access.openapi
properties.description: Whether OpenAPI and Swagger UI routes are accessible without authentication.

properties.name: cap.security.public-access.debug
properties.description: Whether debug routes are public. Enable only in local or dev environments.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.sugar-acidity.assessor
properties.description: Geometry used to classify profile points against built-in sugar-acidity zones.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.generic-yeast-tolerance-min
properties.description: Generic lower pH tolerance used when no yeast-specific tolerance is available.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.cider-guidance-min
properties.description: Lower bound of the curated cider pH guidance range.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.cider-guidance-max
properties.description: Upper bound of the curated cider pH guidance range.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.high-microbial-risk
properties.description: pH at or above which CAP reports elevated microbial risk.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.source-code
properties.description: Stable identifier of the curated pH business-rule source set.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.ph.source-comment
properties.description: Human-readable provenance note for the configured pH business rules.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.yan.severe-low
properties.description: YAN in mg N/L below which CAP reports a severe nitrogen deficiency.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.yan.low
properties.description: YAN in mg N/L below which CAP reports a nitrogen deficiency.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.yan.high
properties.description: YAN in mg N/L above which CAP reports an elevated nitrogen level.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.yan.source-code
properties.description: Stable identifier of the curated YAN business-rule source set.

properties.name: cap.profile-analysis.readiness.yan.source-comment
properties.description: Human-readable provenance note for the configured YAN business rules.
